[SWS_CM_10472] E2E Error Response
⌈
In case E2ECheck reports an
E2E error, the further reception steps are not processed. Further a response message
containing an error structured according to [SWS_CM_10474] shall be constructed.
The ErrorDomain shall be set to E2EError and the ErrorCode shall be set to the corre-
sponding error value of E2E_check according to [SWS_CM_90421].
⌋

[SWS_CM_10472] E2E Error Response
⌈
In case E2E_check (according
to [SWS_CM_90480]) reported an E2E error, an error response message according to
the used network binding (e.g., [SWS_CM_10312] in case of SOME/IP) shall be sent
to the client.
⌋
